'''2022 European Championship''' was the Players Committee European Championship at Zu Den Vier Winden in Bochum, Germany, 9–11 September 2022. [[Emil Wallin]] defeated [[Jonas Hagen Nørregaard]] in the Final Confrontation.<ref name="pc">https://www.starwarsccg.org/2022-09-european-championship/</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Open]]
* '''Site:''' Bochum, Germany
* '''Dates:''' 9–11 September 2022
